name: Momiji
source:
A fairy-like being that lives in the massage parlor, having been a good friend to the previous owner. A strange-looking cat, he’s here to guide the protagonist from a fumbling beginner to a dexterous master. He passes on the secret technique, Mystic Art: Pleasure Rush along with the Ultimate: Celestial Wolf Fang Gloves, an item meant to improve its efficacy, to Atsushi.

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/games/beat-refle]Gematsu[/url]]
